Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>

Subject: POC access & success criteria — Nimbus trial

Hi Tom / Lena — great chat earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the 2-week POC we discussed. Please confirm or flag changes.

Objective (proposed): Validate Redwood inference for Nimbus patient-facing summarization pipeline at 95% quality and <200ms per-request 95th perc token latency under a simulated load of 10 rps.

Success criteria (examples):
- Summaries meet NDA-provided prompt accuracy on 3 representative prompt sets (quantified by BLEU/rouge and manual spot checks).
- Latency: 95th-percentile end-to-end (API to response) <200ms in your target region.
- Cost: target token cost under $0.015 per 1k tokens for the workload profile.
- Operational: ability to authenticate via SSO + scoped API key for automated tests; ability to IP allowlist Redwood demo env.

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0 (this week): Provide list of evaluation prompts, sample payload shapes, and team access details (SSO domain + admin email or API test key recipient).
- Day 1: Redwood provisions test account + SSO invite and/or API key; Vivek to share quick setup checklist and sandbox endpoint.
- Day 2-8: Run integration tests + perf runs; Redwood provides latency/cost dashboards.
- Day 9-14: Score summaries, iterate prompts, mutual decision.

Ownership / asks:
- Nimbus: share SSO domain for SAML/SCIM invite or a user email to invite (preferred), and IP ranges to allowlist if you want API-key based access.
- Redwood: we'll provision sandbox, generate scoped API key (if needed), and send the poc-setup-checklist + sample scripts. Vivek will own tech setup.

Attachments: poc-setup-checklist.pdf (setup steps + common troubleshooting)

Next steps: Please reply with (1) preferred access method (SSO vs API key), (2) SSO domain or user email for invite, (3) any IP ranges to allowlist, and (4) the two representative prompt sets you want evaluated.

Thanks — I’ll schedule the kickoff once we have access details.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa + Tom — adding tech details on our side so you have everything in one place.

1) SSO invites: We support SAML SSO (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated) and SCIM for group sync. For a fast POC, a single admin user invite (email) is easiest — we'll walk you through mapping roles. If you want SCIM, we'll need your SCIM base URL + bearer token (for automated provisioning).

2) API key option: If you prefer API key instead of SSO, we'll create a scoped read/write key limited to the POC project. Please provide a list of allowed outbound IP ranges (CIDR) for our sandbox instance to be allowlisted on your side OR let us know which IPs YOU want us to allow on our firewall. Usually customers provide 1-2 CIDRs.

3) Sandbox endpoints & credentials: I'll provision the sandbox once we have the preferred access method. I've attached the poc-setup-checklist.pdf with the commands and a small Python script to run a smoke test.

4) Telemetry: We'll enable per-request tracing and cost counters for the POC. If you have any telemetry constraints (PII masking, retention limits), tell us and we'll adjust.

I can provision an API key and post it to a secure DocuSign-protected link or issue a direct SSO invite — your choice.

Vivek
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: poc-setup-checklist.pdf
